item: Simple mode round 3: first-run start choice, Search paging and language filter, walk fixes
key_paths: src/static/simple/simple.js; src/static/simple/simple.css; src/static/app-core.js; src/static/app.css; src/static/index.html; tests/test_simple_mode.py
summary: The first-run guide shows both views side by side with nothing preselected (R710 = b; a guide closed with no pick stays in the full view), applied after the guide closes; Search shows more than its first 20 results and filters by language with corpus counts; Today waits while leads are still being built instead of saying nothing stands out; on phones the top bar fits one row; larger tap targets and marks, a focus ring on form fields, spoken names for World and Numbers rows; browser walk of every view in three themes and Arabic at phone and desktop widths; strings x12.
